title: can't obtain
description: Adds every unobtainable, unused, not-having-a-block-form item from JE/BE.
body:
A simple, but useful for some people tweak that adds an item form for unused, unobtainable blocks from Java Edition and Bedrock Edition.

Where are these items? In the operator items tab. To enable this tab, go to controls, and enable "Operator Items Tab" setting.

You can use it in any modpack, no credits required.
